definitions.non_base_compensation_signal: Schema-valid rating rows with non_base_compensation_signal_strength greater than zero.
definitions.direct_base_wage_value_signal: Schema-valid rating rows with base_wage_direct_value_strength greater than zero. This is a direct value/schedule signal universe, not a count of complete wage schedules.
definitions.explicit_schedule_tagged_subset: Direct-base-value signal rows whose controlled quant_span_types include salary_schedule, wage_schedule, step_schedule, or grade_or_payband.
definitions.side_assignment: Join by span_id to normalized_quantitative_records. Preserve police, fire, combined_safety, and non_safety exactly. Map mixed, unclear, missing, or non-unique side assignments to unclear. No free-text side inference was used for aggregate counts.
definitions.reason_for_conservative_side_assignment: A unit-specific title can coexist with a town-wide table or a span for another occupation. Using only the controlled normalized side field avoids converting source-title hints into false side labels. Selected examples were separately checked against their exact spans and source titles.

nonbase_component_tag_counts_by_side.note: Tags are multi-label and therefore do not sum to span totals.

schedule_tag_counts_by_side.note: Controlled schedule tags are multi-label. One unclear-side row carries more than one schedule tag, so component tags sum to 662 while the unique-row total remains 661.

conclusions.answer: Yes. The controlled normalized side field identifies 226 non-safety non-base spans across 100 sources and 96 municipality-state combinations. Exact examples include clerical opt-out stipends, public-works shift differentials, boot/clothing allowances, longevity pay, and certification stipends.
conclusions.safety_heavy_or_mixed: Mixed, but safety-heavy among side-resolved rows. Police, fire, and combined-safety account for 1,528 of 1,754 side-resolved non-base spans (87.12%). Because 1,964 of 3,718 rows (52.82%) are side-unclear, this is a property of the resolved evidence layer, not a corpus-wide prevalence estimate.
conclusions.report_language_repair: Use '3,718 valid rated non-base signals' rather than implying 3,718 complete, side-coded provisions. Use '2,687 direct base-wage/value signals, including 661 explicitly schedule-tagged spans' rather than '2,687 wage schedules.'
conclusions.prevalence_boundary: The processed queue is selected and more than half of each signal universe is side-unclear. No national or population prevalence conclusion is supported.
